role: development feasibility of the fixed public policy library, with no optimizer or certification comparison
registration_context: one April day and isolated 2023 source availability known; no replenishment-policy outcomes observed

asset.name: public two-hour reference battery
asset.capacity_basis: published Jamesfield site is 49 MW/98 MWh; Pillswood site is 98 MW/196 MWh
asset.asset_scope: reference asset with recorded unit workload; 98 MWh is not a measured E_PILLB-1 energy capacity

signal: max(forecast level q05-q95, absolute half-hour forecast ramp divided by calibration q95); calibrate only on 2022 forecasts

control.target_soc: interpolate the quantized policy at the delivery-period forecast stress, multiplied by 98 MWh
control.forecast_visibility: delivery-period and preceding forecasts must have publishTime no later than nomination time
control.projection: current SOC plus already nominated baseline energy over the next hour, assuming no additional dispatcher intervention
control.command: bounded constant import/export power over the future half-hour, aiming from the projected inventory to the policy target
control.execution: most recent received covering BOA overrides nominated baseline; resume nominated baseline outside BOA segments
control.request_visibility: acceptanceTime is the simulated receipt time; no future receipts used
control.integration: exact piecewise-linear gross energy, split at zero and power limits
control.supported_time_grid: instruction timeFrom/timeTo/acceptanceTime on whole UTC minutes, as in the supplied ordinary BOA data
control.physical_bounds: clip delivered power and energy to the reference asset; retain all undelivered baseline and BOA energy separately

cost.objective: net metered-energy procurement proxy in GBP plus inventory mark-to-market adjustment
cost.flows: sum APXMIDP[t] * (delivered_import_MWh - delivered_export_MWh), including baseline and instruction flows
cost.inventory_adjustment: charge_efficiency is not used for sale value: lambda_T = discharge_efficiency * final settlement-period MID; add lambda_T * (common_initial_SOC - final_SOC)
cost.price_visibility: realized prices and lambda_T are accounting outcomes only; the controller never observes them
cost.scope: MID-indexed energy accounting; BM pay-as-bid revenues, fees and degradation are outside this pilot cost

failure.event: any nominated baseline or dispatcher request cannot be delivered within power or energy limits
failure.threshold_scope: analyst finite-population feasibility criterion, not a market permission to disregard instructions

windows.population: all complete windows inside each fixed ten-day development sample; common reset inventory per diagnostic window

gate: advance only if at least one of the actual 64 library profiles is empirically feasible in all three development samples and at least one library profile is infeasible in at least one sample; extra constants do not open the gate
model_assumptions: single-service reference asset with no other commitments besides its modeled nominations and received exogenous BOA workload
historical BOA requests are held fixed although actual acceptances depended on the original participant baseline and availability
98 MWh is modeled usable energy; unit-specific usable energy and SOC were not observed
nominations impose a one-hour physical-information lead; order-book execution and exact BM financial settlement are not simulated
